SELECT
u.name AS studentName,
a.name AS academyName,
c.name AS className,
( SELECT name FROM users WHERE user_id = #{teacherId} ) AS teacherName,
( SELECT ea.total_score
FROM exam_attempts ea
JOIN exams e ON e.exam_id = ea.exam_id
WHERE ea.student_id = #{studentId}
AND ea.attempt_no = 1
AND ea.attempt_type = 'EXAM'
AND ea.status = 'GRADED'
AND e.exam_type IN ('MONTHLY', 'MONTH')
AND e.exam_date BETWEEN #{periodStart} AND #{periodEnd}
ORDER BY e.exam_date DESC, ea.graded_at DESC
LIMIT 1
) AS monthlyExamScore,
( SELECT ROUND( AVG(ea2.total_score), 1 )
FROM exam_attempts ea2
WHERE ea2.exam_id = (
SELECT ea.exam_id
FROM exam_attempts ea
JOIN exams e ON e.exam_id = ea.exam_id
WHERE ea.student_id = #{studentId}
AND ea.attempt_no = 1
AND ea.attempt_type = 'EXAM'
AND ea.status = 'GRADED'
AND e.exam_type IN ('MONTHLY', 'MONTH')
AND e.exam_date BETWEEN #{periodStart} AND #{periodEnd}
ORDER BY e.exam_date DESC, ea.graded_at DESC
LIMIT 1 )
AND ea2.attempt_no = 1
AND ea2.attempt_type = 'EXAM'
AND ea2.status = 'GRADED'
) AS classAverageScore,
( SELECT COALESCE( ROUND( COUNT( DISTINCT CASE WHEN ea.attempt_id IS NOT NULL THEN e.exam_id END ) * 100.0 / NULLIF( COUNT( DISTINCT e.exam_id ), 0 ), 1 ), 0 )
FROM exams e
JOIN class_students cs ON cs.class_id = e.class_id AND cs.student_id = #{studentId} AND cs.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN exam_attempts ea ON ea.exam_id = e.exam_id AND ea.student_id = #{studentId} AND ea.status = 'GRADED' AND ea.attempt_type = 'EXAM'
WHERE e.exam_type = 'WORD'
AND e.exam_date BETWEEN #{periodStart} AND #{periodEnd}
) AS wordExamCompletionRate,
( SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM reading_reports rr
WHERE rr.student_id = #{studentId}
AND rr.submitted_at >= #{periodStart}
AND rr.submitted_at < DATE_ADD( #{periodEnd}, INTERVAL 1 DAY )
) AS booksReadCount,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT review_answer.question_id FROM exam_attempts review_attempt JOIN exam_answers review_answer ON review_answer.attempt_id = review_attempt.attempt_id WHERE review_attempt.student_id = #{studentId} AND review_attempt.attempt_type = 'REVIEW' AND review_attempt.status = 'GRADED' AND review_answer.is_correct = TRUE AND DATE(review_attempt.graded_at) BETWEEN #{periodStart} AND #{periodEnd} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM exam_answers original_answer WHERE original_answer.attempt_id = review_attempt.source_attempt_id AND original_answer.question_id = review_answer.question_id AND original_answer.is_correct = FALSE )
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT daily_answer.question_id FROM daily_review_attempts daily_attempt JOIN daily_review_answers daily_answer ON daily_answer.daily_review_attempt_id = daily_attempt.daily_review_attempt_id WHERE daily_attempt.student_id = #{studentId} AND daily_attempt.status = 'GRADED' AND daily_answer.is_correct = TRUE AND DATE(daily_attempt.graded_at) BETWEEN #{periodStart} AND #{periodEnd} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM exam_attempts original_attempt JOIN exam_answers original_answer ON original_answer.attempt_id = original_attempt.attempt_id WHERE original_attempt.student_id = #{studentId} AND original_attempt.attempt_type = 'EXAM' AND original_attempt.status = 'GRADED' AND original_answer.question_id = daily_answer.question_id AND original_answer.is_correct = FALSE ) ) overcome_questions ) AS overcomeWrongCount,
( SELECT
COALESCE(
NULLIF( eq.small_category, '' ),
NULLIF( eq.large_category, '' ),
'분석 중'
)
FROM exam_answers ans
JOIN exam_questions eq ON eq.question_id = ans.question_id
JOIN exam_attempts ea ON ea.attempt_id = ans.attempt_id
JOIN exams e ON e.exam_id = ea.exam_id
WHERE ea.student_id = #{studentId}
AND ea.attempt_no = 1
AND ea.attempt_type = 'EXAM'
AND ea.status = 'GRADED'
AND ( NULLIF(TRIM(eq.small_category), '') IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(eq.large_category), '') IS NOT NULL )
AND e.exam_date BETWEEN #{periodStart} AND #{periodEnd}
GROUP BY
COALESCE(
NULLIF( eq.small_category, '' ),
NULLIF( eq.large_category, '' ),
'분석 중'
)
ORDER BY ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN ans.is_correct = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(ans.answer_id), 0), 1 ) ASC, COUNT(ans.answer_id) DESC
LIMIT 1
) AS topWeakTypeTag
FROM users u
JOIN academies a ON a.academy_id = u.academy_id
LEFT JOIN class_students cs ON cs.student_id = u.user_id
AND cs.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN classes c ON c.class_id = cs.class_id
WHERE u.user_id = #{studentId}
LIMIT 1

SELECT
es.section_name AS category,
ROUND(
COALESCE( SUM(ans.earned_score), 0 )
* 100.0
/
NULLIF( SUM(eq.score), 0 ),
1
) AS score
FROM exam_sections es
JOIN exam_questions eq ON eq.section_id = es.section_id
LEFT JOIN exam_attempts ea ON ea.exam_id = es.exam_id
AND ea.student_id = #{studentId}
AND ea.attempt_no = 1
AND ea.status = 'GRADED'
AND ea.attempt_id = (
SELECT MAX(ea2.attempt_id)
FROM exam_attempts ea2
WHERE ea2.exam_id = es.exam_id
AND ea2.student_id = #{studentId}
AND ea2.attempt_no = 1
AND ea2.status = 'GRADED' )
LEFT JOIN exam_answers ans ON ans.attempt_id = ea.attempt_id
AND ans.question_id = eq.question_id
WHERE es.exam_id = (
SELECT e.exam_id
FROM exams e
WHERE e.exam_type IN ( 'MONTHLY', 'MONTH' )
AND e.exam_date BETWEEN #{periodStart} AND #{periodEnd}
AND e.class_id = (
SELECT cs.class_id
FROM class_students cs
WHERE cs.student_id = #{studentId}
AND cs.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY cs.class_student_id DESC
LIMIT 1 )
ORDER BY e.exam_date DESC, e.exam_id DESC
LIMIT 1 )
AND TRIM( es.section_name ) <> ''
GROUP BY
es.section_id,
es.section_name,
es.sort_order
ORDER BY
es.sort_order,
es.section_id

WITH ranked_monthly_scores AS ( SELECT e.exam_id, e.exam_date, DATE_FORMAT(e.exam_date, '%Y-%m') AS monthLabel, ea.total_score AS studentScore, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY DATE_FORMAT(e.exam_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY e.exam_date DESC, e.exam_id DESC, ea.graded_at DESC ) AS monthRank FROM exams e JOIN exam_attempts ea ON ea.exam_id = e.exam_id WHERE e.exam_type IN ('MONTHLY', 'MONTH') AND ea.student_id = #{studentId} AND ea.attempt_no = 1 AND ea.attempt_type = 'EXAM' AND ea.status = 'GRADED' ) SELECT ranked.monthLabel, ROUND(ranked.studentScore, 1) AS studentScore, ( SELECT ROUND(AVG(class_attempt.total_score), 1) FROM exam_attempts class_attempt WHERE class_attempt.exam_id = ranked.exam_id AND class_attempt.attempt_no = 1 AND class_attempt.attempt_type = 'EXAM' AND class_attempt.status = 'GRADED' ) AS classScore FROM ranked_monthly_scores ranked WHERE ranked.monthRank = 1 ORDER BY ranked.exam_date ASC, ranked.exam_id ASC
